method: Fresh full-text manual review of all 48 current deploy production, shell entrypoint and documentation files after this freeze. Traced CLI/RPC allowlists and lock ordering, privileged versus native UID boundaries, bounded inputs/subprocesses/archive imports, account proof and same-connection credential verification, original identity reservation and initialization resumption, release publication/fsync and previous-pointer recovery, whole-control-tree replacement and start barriers, HTTPS hostname/trust/proof/port preflights and compensated migration, provider generation/host policy retention, native subprocess cleanup, descriptor-relative workspace/Git/index/worktree reads and mutations, durable receipt versus diagnostic evidence, backup/restore and service-removal maintenance runbooks. Compared documented commands, paths, modes and limitations with their actual implementations. Read the historical-evidence appendix as dated prior claims, not current tests or acceptance. No tests or server mutations performed by this audit. All inspected file hashes and the complete source digest were rechecked unchanged. Additionally read scripts/snapshot.mjs and scripts/run-tests.mjs in full as release context: explicit evidence exclusions, ordinary-file checks, scope coverage and timestamp gates, exact targeted inventory, isolated execution and test-result reconciliation. This expands this production/deployment review to 50 files.
